That name would be tracked but I wouldn't consider it too seriously until it shows up in another story. But in the case of OWO-1, that's from the Episode I script so the Shakespeare book pulled from that.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/IFPlf}} was an [[OOM command battle droid]] stationed aboard the ''[[Saak'ak]]'' in [[32 BBY]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo]]. It was sent by [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation]] [[Nute Gunray]] to make certain that [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his apprentice, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], had been killed by a dose of deadly [[dioxis]] gas. Going with a squad of [[OOM-series security droid]]s, the droid commander went to the gas-filled room and saw that the gas had not functioned properly. Moments later, the droid and its squad were destroyed by the [[Jedi]]. {{Droid-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== OWO-1 was named in the script for [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. The name later appeared in the non-[[canon]] adaption ''[[William Shakespeare's The Phantom of Menace: Star Wars Part the First]]''. ==Appearances== *{{Film|I}} {{1st}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *''[[William Shakespeare's The Phantom of Menace: Star Wars Part the First]]'' ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]'' {{Po}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Doors Opening Vs.
